import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values;P=df['P'].values;y=df['dP_dt'].values
def m(p):
    return (p[0]*np.log(1+p[1]*t)*np.sqrt(P) + p[2]*(P**2/(1+p[3]*P**2)) + p[4]*np.exp(-p[5]*P**2)*np.sqrt(t) + p[6]*P**2)
p0=np.array([-3.26,0.106,-0.351,0.0463,-2.2,0.111,-0.188])
r=least_squares(lambda p: m(p)-y, p0, xtol=1e-15, ftol=1e-15, gtol=1e-15)
print(repr(r.x), np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(y))
